copy_tail.role: restores r0 then calls memcpy 0x02048cce with original r2=0x9c

current_selector_semantics.source_mapping: source_slot = trigger_note - 36 for Ch10 trigger notes 36..51 when S1-C3 state is ARMED and selected slot valid == 1
current_selector_semantics.fallback: all non-Ch10, out-of-range, non-ARMED, and invalid selected slots keep original source r1
current_selector_semantics.trigger_note_metadata: unchanged in current candidate because r5/r6 are restored before stock sb note stores
current_selector_semantics.synth_consumer: stock post-copy metadata consumes r5 for Note Off note and r6 for Note On note

playback_note_design.required_semantics: trigger_note remains the incoming Pad/MIDI note and MIDI OUT argument; playback_note is the local synth note stored into the voice metadata and used symmetrically for Note On and Note Off
playback_note_design.selector_side_lookup: playback_note = playback_map[trigger_note - 36] when Ch10 and trigger_note in 36..51; Original/null maps to trigger_note
playback_note_design.source_substitution: source_slot = playback_note - 36 if playback_note is within the resident 36..51 S1-C3 slot set and valid; otherwise fail closed to trigger_note/current fallback per chosen policy
playback_note_design.metadata_substitution: after the playback lookup, Note Off must make stock 0x0201c648 store playback_note instead of trigger_note in r5; Note On must make stock 0x0201c686 store playback_note instead of trigger_note in r6 while preserving velocity r5
playback_note_design.midi_out_preservation: do not mutate the incoming message buffer or pad/MIDI OUT caller argument; only alter the local synth consumer metadata after MIDI OUT routing and inside the local note dispatcher wrapper
playback_note_design.note_off_symmetry: the Note Off entry must run the identical trigger_slot -> playback_note lookup as Note On. Any separate Note On-only substitution repeats the known stuck-note class.
playback_note_design.fail_closed_rule: if mapping metadata is absent, unpublished, out of 0..127, or unsupported by resident-slot source constraints, leave current S1-C3 behavior unchanged

blockers.evidence: Current web tool carries playbackNotes through the document and transmission queue, but sendAll warns that before a corresponding firmware protocol is installed only patch data is transmitted. Current S1-C3 runtime packets/proven producer have no validated playback-note metadata writer.
blockers.required_resolution: Define and validate exact v15 offline transport, storage, publication, and hash gates for 16 playback-note values before firmware can consume them.

blockers.evidence: Current selector push/pop 7904/5904 restores r5 and r6, while stock synth metadata stores happen after wrapper return at 0x0201c648 and 0x0201c686.
blockers.required_resolution: Prove exact PI32 code that returns with r5 substituted on Note Off and r6 substituted on Note On while preserving Note On velocity r5, r7/r6 destination context as needed, r9 channel, r2=0x9c, and all stock fallbacks.

blockers.evidence: Resident S1-C3 source slots are proven only for notes 36..51; UI validation currently accepts Playback Note 0..127.
blockers.required_resolution: Either constrain firmware-consumed playback notes to resident 36..51 for source substitution, or separately prove a source for notes outside that range.

repeated_hit_polyphony_assessment.same_trigger_same_playback: Equivalent to repeated hits of one MIDI note after substitution. It depends on stock voice allocation and stealing, which this offline analysis does not extend.
repeated_hit_polyphony_assessment.different_triggers_same_playback: Ambiguous if stock release matching keys only on stored synth note. Since exact rows prove the stored note is the consumer-visible identity and no trigger-pad identity store is proven here, many-to-one playback mappings can cross-release or steal each other. Treat as unsupported until a trigger identity field or active-note map is proven.
repeated_hit_polyphony_assessment.different_triggers_different_playback: Expected to behave like independent stock notes, subject to stock polyphony limits, because Note On and Note Off store and match distinct playback notes.
repeated_hit_polyphony_assessment.note_off_requirement: For every Note On mapping T -> P, the corresponding Note Off for T must compute the same P and store/consume P. This is mandatory for stuck-note safety.
